I cannot fathom why these guys thought it would be a good idea to make the graph’s time periods rolling. e.g. the 1D graph to be a rolling 24hr rather than simply today (i.e. since the start of day). 
It’s bizarre. 
If you see a +1.0% daily move in this idiotic app, that doesn’t mean the asset is up +1.0% today. Like every other trading app. No. That would be too sensible. Instead, it means it’s up +1.0% vs this time 24hr ago. Why?? That’s a useless metric. 
Also, the graphs don’t have axes or useful guide lines (e.g. a line for today’s starting price, or a line for your average cost price), so your only way of reading the plot points is to manually use the tap-and-hold. 
Utterly rubbish design. 
Impossible to quickly and intuitively keep track of your performance in a meaningful way.
There is a tremendous amount of information available, which is good, but I do have problems navigating to find what I want to see.
